description: TrustedFlash(TM) v1.0 - microSD is SanDisk's proprietary TrustedFlash v1.0 advanced security technology. It implements FIPS-Approved algorithms including AES, Triple-DES, RSA, SHA, HMAC, and ANSI X9.31 RNG. They provide authentication, data encryption/decryption, and signature generation/verification functions for TrustedFlash(TM) v1.0 - microSD.
